title: Didn’t work on the door I needed it for.
text: Didn’t work on the door I needed it for.. I wanted a solution for our 30” back door which is exposed to the elements. The 2 inch Draft Stopper didn’t work. I then tried the product on the 36 inch front door. I had to cut away more bolster than the 36 inch length for the door to close. I don’t know what to say, The jury is still out.
